shortDescription: MOSCOW, Sept 11 (Reuters) - Russia’s central bank on Friday left its key interest rate (RUCBIR=ECI) unchanged at 14% , the bank said in a statement on its website.(Reporting by Moscow Newsroom) ((Moscow Newsroom, +7 495 775 1242, e-mail: Moscow.newsroom@thomsonreuters.com))
